name: First recorded historical mention of a football-like game
description: An ancient Chinese text mentions a game called 'cuju', which resembles modern football.

name: Ancient Rome
description: A game known as 'Harpastum' is played during the Roman Empire. It involves kicking a ball and is reminiscent of modern football.

name: Medieval football
description: The game of 'mob football' is played in Medieval Europe, involving large numbers of players and rudimentary ball.

name: Codification of football rules
description: The Laws of the Game are officially codified in England, marking the beginning of organized football.

name: Formation of the English Football Association (FA)
description: The FA is founded in England, becoming the world's first official governing body for football.

name: First international football match
description: England and Scotland play the first recognized international football match.

name: Introduction of the penalty kick
description: The penalty kick is introduced to the Laws of the Game.

name: Formation of FIFA
description: The Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA) is established as the governing body for international football.

name: First FIFA World Cup
description: The inaugural FIFA World Cup takes place in Uruguay, with 13 teams participating.

name: Introduction of floodlights
description: Floodlights are used for the first time in a football match, allowing games to be played at night.

name: First UEFA European Championship
description: The UEFA European Championship, known as the Euro, is launched.

name: Introduction of the yellow card
description: The yellow card is introduced to caution players for minor offenses.

name: Introduction of the red card
description: The red card is introduced to send off players for serious offenses or accumulating too many yellow cards.

name: Creation of the Premier League
description: The FA Premier League is formed as the top professional football league in England.

name: Introduction of VAR (Video Assistant Referee)
description: VAR is implemented to assist referees in making accurate decisions.

name: Hosted by Russia, the 2018 FIFA World Cup
description: The 21st FIFA World Cup takes place in Russia.

name: Development of the women's football
description: Women's football gains increased popularity and recognition worldwide.

name: Hosted by France, the 2019 FIFA Women's World Cup
description: The 8th FIFA Women's World Cup is held in France.

name: Introduction of the VAR in UEFA competitions
description: UEFA introduces VAR for all major competitions, including the UEFA Champions League.

name: Postponed due to COVID-19, Hosted by Japan, the Tokyo 2020 Summer Olympics
description: The 2020 Summer Olympics, including football competitions, are postponed to 2021 due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

name: Development of women's football, 21st-century
description: Women's football continues to grow globally, with increased access and investment.
